Prices

Questions

How much do projects in business systems and integrations cost?
An MVP in this group costs $2,000–70,000 (UZS 24–845 mln), a full version up to $300,000. The exact price depends on the solution, the integrations and the scope.
How long does it take?
An MVP takes 2–20 weeks, a full version 6–60 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
How the work runs today: who does what; Existing data: Excel, notebooks or an old system; 1–2 staff to try the system.
